title: Woodrow Wilson — The Journey That Made The Name #Shorts
description:
Between the birth and the legend of Woodrow Wilson lie the years that actually decide it. Thomas Woodrow Wilson (December 28, 1856 – February 3, 1924) was the 28th president of the United States, serving from 1913 to 1921. He was the only Democrat to serve as president during the Progressive Era, when Republicans dominated the presidency and legislative branches.

To understand where Woodrow Wilson ended up, start with where Woodrow Wilson began. Wilson's textbook, The State, was widely used in American college courses until the 1920s. Saunders, seemed to indicate that Wilson "was laying the groundwork for the modern welfare state." His third book, Division and Reunion (1893), became a standard university textbook for teaching mid- and late-19th century U.S. history.
